behavior: Constructor captures request once using mapped name
Update refreshes result and error via GetLoadedAssetBundle(name,out string error,out int referenceCount); reference count ignored, result null means continue Update
IEnumerator MoveNext only negates IsDone and does not call Update; Current null, Reset no-op
Non-null result wrapper is done with progress1, regardless of contained AssetBundle nullness
Absent result: missing captured request or null error means pending; literal error 0 means pending, other errors (including empty) log and complete
IsDone catches Exception during error comparison/logging, logs exception and returns false
Progress otherwise returns zero for missing request or native request.downloadProgress
LoadAsync logs original name if enabled, remaps variant, loads mapped name with false flag, constructs operation then adds it to shared operations list
implementation: OutgameLegacyBundleOperation implements existing package operation interface; OutgameLegacyBundleRequests restores dispatch. Downloader and manager operation Update loop remain explicit external seams.

validation.nativeRequest: Created/disposed UnityWebRequest for capture/progress tests; no SendWebRequest or network transfer.

limitations: GetLoadedAssetBundle dependency/refcount registry, manager Update operation pumping, variant mapping and native downloader not implemented here.
No positive AssetBundle-to-UI native loading validation yet.

correction.detail: Third out int of GetLoadedAssetBundle23812 is a missing-dependency marker (0 default, 1 when a direct dependency wrapper is absent), not referenceCount. Runtime previously ignored it; naming corrected.
